runs.name: IDACORP, Inc.; NYSE IDA, SEC CIK 0001057877; holding company whose principal subsidiary Idaho Power is an electric utility regulated by the Idaho and Oregon commissions and the FERC, about 664,000 retail customers in southern Idaho and eastern Oregon, one deciding part; Oregon distribution and certain Oregon transmission assets under a signed sale to OTEC (2026-02-13); Idaho rate case settled at 9.6% ROE 2025-12-30; forward equity sales of 2025 and a $600M ATM with forwards 2026-05-15; the 10-K names no rival company, Avista and NorthWestern chosen as a CONVENTION of the run
runs.entry: Price **$142.06** (close 2026-10-22 through `tools/sources.py`, aggregator, flagged). Shares **57,842,043** at 2026-07-24 (10-Q cover 0001057877-26-000129, `Screens/cover_shares.py`; Idaho Power's 39,150,812 shares wholly owned and not added; 56,115K at 2026-06-30 plus 1,726,727 forward shares settled 2026-07-13 agrees; `run.py`'s 10-K cover count of 54.899M stale and not used; about 5.75M forward-sold shares, about $715M, unsettled and shown beside); market cap $8,217M. Sovereign **5.29%**, US Treasury daily par yield curve, 30-year, 2026-10-22. Read from the 10-K for FY2025 (0001057877-26-000028), the 10-Q for Q2 2026, the 2026 proxy (0001057877-26-000091), the rate case 8-Ks of 2025-05-30 and 2025-12-31, the FY2020, FY2022 and FY2023 10-Ks; operating cash 2025 cross-checked to the filed statement. Lines of evidence derived by the analyst from Items 1, 1A and 7, six lines stated in the run file. Stock pay resolved from the statements of equity (n/f in XBRL); capital spending taken net of transmission partners' reimbursements ($151.9M in 2025). **Q1 IN**: a cost-of-service utility whose ten-year economics are written in its filings and resource plans. **Q2 IN**: a legal franchise no attacker can cross, protecting a regulator-set ordinary return carried to Q3 as a second best; ROE mean 2016 to 2025 IDACORP 9.5%, Avista 7.6% (to 2024), NorthWestern 8.8% (to 2023); BPA does not file, PacifiCorp and NV Energy inside Berkshire Hathaway Energy's filing and not read; IDACORP's 2024 and 2025 about 8.3% and 8.2% without the extra tax-credit amortization. **Q3 weighs against**: a compulsory reinvestor, the added equity earning 4.5% to 8.5% 2020 to 2025, owner cash after all spending negative in four of five years. **Q4 no STOP, weighs against lightly**: ten balance sheets read (assets $6.29B 2016 to $10.87B mid-2026, long-term debt $1.75B to $3.68B plus a $214M finance lease, equity $2.15B to $3.77B); equity AFUDC $62.5M and tax-credit amortization $40.3M, 31% of 2025 net income; Hells Canyon relicensing $536M in construction in progress, licence pending since 2005. **Q5 integrity IN**, no tells found; the annual EPS guidance and an 18-year EPS streak that in 2024 rested on the IPUC tax-credit backstop weighed, disclosed in every release, no doubt formed; ability weighs for lightly. **Q6 weighs against**: Part A, about 58% paid out while new shares and forwards raise more than is paid ($396M in 2024 and 2025); no buyback, the buyback line written back from Q7 (no programme; every share issued, $107.78 to about $139.5, sold above the top of the range); Part B, short- and long-term pay on adjusted net income and EPS with no capital charge. **Q7 OUT, on the floor**, equity-only central under Q7, The regulated utility, at the allowed debt share of 49% (the 2025 settlement's 7.41% return reconciled): owner cash 2021 to 2025 maintenance only (depreciation the guess) **$216.4M a year**, all spending -$225.0M, all spending credited $69.2M; net new long-term debt $1,471.0M credited against the growth spending, $294.2M a year (net of retirements, a CONVENTION of the run; gross $318.2M and year-by-year $222.1M beside); specific (f) cut the maintenance series' 16.9% to the company's own sales growth of 5.60%; the company's actual cash tax used, the shelter rule of Whose tax not applied under flow-through rates (a CONVENTION of the run, about $35M a year at 21% beside); the Oregon sale beside at about -$0.9 a share. Value range **$70.72 to $91.45 a share equity-only** (all spending credited, no growth, $22.60 beside; with the forward shares about $75.6 to $94.4; all-equity $32.73 and $29.83); expected return at the price 2.63% no growth, 3.69% growth, against the floor and the bond at 5.29%; the price above the top of the range; fair price **$38.36 equity-only, central**, all-equity -$24.49, not positive. Q8 to Q12 not reached. After the stop, facts recorded, not weighed: maturities $116.3M in 2026 (repaid July), none 2027 to 2029; covenant leverage 52% against a 65% limit; interest $204.4M against pre-tax income $310.4M including $62.5M of equity AFUDC; Moody's outlook negative, S&P stable; wildfire claims arrive "regularly", insurance "may not be sufficient". Commits 5fca580d (template), ee316775 (Step 0, Q1), a3b72f4f (Q2), eea1e6fb (Q3 with Q4), 5db29557 (Q5 with Q6), 3578d73c (Q7 with the Q6 write-back), bce1c82b (close). Departures declared by the analyst: the research and the Q7 arithmetic gathered in the research folder before Q1 was written (no entry language, entered the run file only at Q7); Q3 with Q4 and Q5 with Q6 committed as pairs. A stray duplicate Q4 heading marked *(pending)* is left at the end of the Q4 section (a template residue; not fixed in the run file, operator rule 6). Position note filled at the fold: not held. Contamination declared: a `Test Runs/` listing showing EDN, ENIC, ES, ETR, EVRG, FE, FTS and HE run names of 2026-10-23, HE commit subjects, the AVA line of the adopted 2026-10-18 utility case, the memory index; none used. Citations: the analyst's `check_run.py` every id found, every fragment in its row, no E-id; the dispatcher's `dispatcher_fragcheck.py` 115 id marks, no E-id, no missing id, 20 adjacent quoted fragments, **no citation slip**. No tracked research file over 200 KB. check_framework PASS. **For the operator** (the analyst's framework notes): (1) the utility debt credit does not say gross or net of refinancing, nor whether the cap is applied to the window or year by year ($294.2M, $318.2M or $222.1M a year on IDA); (2) the utility paragraph and specific (e) do not say how they combine ($22.60 against $70.72 a share for the no-growth case); (3) Whose tax does not fit flow-through regulation; (4) forward-sold shares have no stated place on the equity-only basis; (5) `run.py` misses partners' reimbursements of joint transmission and stock pay found only in the statement of equity; (6) Q6's serial-issuance STOP still unresolved for a utility issuing by design. Could not get: a maintenance and growth split of capital spending; PacifiCorp's figures; the rivals' 2024 and 2025 year-end equity; the collateral a downgrade could require. Armed at the equity-only fair price.
runs.narr: OUT at Q7 (IDACORP, IDA; holding company of Idaho Power, a regulated electric utility in southern Idaho and eastern Oregon, Oregon assets under a signed sale to OTEC; Q1 IN; Q2 IN, a legal franchise protecting a regulator-set return, ROE 9.5% against Avista 7.6% and NorthWestern 8.8%; Q3 against, compulsory reinvestment, added equity 4.5% to 8.5%; Q4 against lightly, equity AFUDC and tax-credit amortization 31% of 2025 income; Q5 integrity IN, guidance kept by a disclosed tax-credit backstop weighed; Q6 against, dividends paid while issuing shares, pay with no capital charge; owner cash $216.4M a year maintenance only, $147.2M of growth spending equity-funded after the debt credit at 49%; value range $70.72 to $91.45 equity-only vs $142.06, 2.63% to 3.69% at the price; fair $38.36 equity-only, -$24.49 all-equity; no citation slip; not held; armed at the equity-only fair price; framework gaps for the operator: the utility debt credit gross or net and its cap, its fit with specific (e), Whose tax under flow-through rates, forward-sold shares, run.py's utility lines, the serial-issuance STOP)
